about_the_game:
DICERAY is a strategic grid-based puzzle roguelike where you slide dice to match colors, then form poker-style hands based on their values. Each procedurally generated level limits your moves and raises the score goal for the next stage, creating a steady climb in difficulty that rewards planning, adaptability, and clever play.

Plan every move. Build powerful hands. Outthink the challenge.

Key Features

  • Unique dice-matching system where you combine colors and values to create high-scoring poker hands.

  • Deep tactical gameplay with limited moves per level, encouraging careful planning and smart risk-taking.

  • Procedurally generated levels with increasing score targets for endless replayability.

  • Strategic upgrades, including cards, spells, and mythological power-ups, that enhance your runs.

  • Streamlined mechanics paired with the unpredictability of roguelike progression.
